mapper.select: SELECT id,category_code,category_name,status,sort_no,version,created_at,updated_at FROM encyclopedia_category ORDER BY sort_no ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT b.id,b.category_id,b.name,b.aliases,b.tags,b.summary,b.cover_url,b.status,b.sort_no,b.version,b.updated_at, c.category_code,c.category_name
ORDER BY b.sort_no ASC, b.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT b.id,b.category_id,b.name,b.aliases,b.tags,b.summary,b.cover_url,b.body_type, b.description_html,b.care_advice_html,b.health_tips_html,b.status,b.sort_no,b.version,b.created_at,b.updated_at, c.category_code,c.category_name FROM encyclopedia_breed b JOIN encyclopedia_category c ON c.id=b.category_id WHERE b.id=#{breedId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM encyclopedia_breed WHERE category_id=#{categoryId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM encyclopedia_breed WHERE category_id=#{categoryId} AND status='PUBLISHED'
SELECT id, canonical_version, params_sha256, params_canonical, status, receipt_json FROM command_idempotency WHERE request_key = #{requestKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO command_idempotency(id, request_key, canonical_version, params_sha256, params_canonical, status, receipt_json, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{requestKey}, #{canonicalVersion}, #{paramsSha256}, #{paramsCanonical}, 'RESERVED', NULL, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE command_idempotency SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', receipt_json = #{receiptJson}, succeeded_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE request_key = #{requestKey} AND status = 'RESERVED'
